dimensions.assessment: Directly applies to the President of the United States regarding specific personal tort claims and settlement payments handled by the Department of Justice.
dimensions.evidence: result in a personal payment to the President, whether in the form of a settlement or any other payment... for the personal benefit of the President

dimensions.assessment: Bars a specific category of federal fund disbursements related to personal legal claims for a single federal officeholder.
dimensions.evidence: None of the funds made available to the Department of Justice... may be used to approve or facilitate a claim that... results in a personal payment to the President

dimensions.assessment: Prevents potential specific payouts from the Judgment Fund or DOJ funds, but does not alter general government spending levels or tax revenues on a broad scale.
Places a specific restriction on DOJ fund usage and Judgment Fund disbursements regarding tort claims for the President.
dimensions.evidence: To prohibit funds made available to the Department of Justice from being used to make a personal payment to the President

dimensions.assessment: Permanent restriction applying to past, present, and future Department of Justice funds.
dimensions.evidence: None of the funds made available to the Department of Justice before, on, or after the date of enactment of this Act may be used

missing_information: Any pending or anticipated tort claim amounts involving the President
importance_detail.rationale: Prohibits Department of Justice funds from being used to approve or facilitate personal payments or settlements to the President under the Federal Tort Claims Act or the Judgment Fund.

label: S. 4124

latest_action.text: Read the second time. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 359.

title: A bill to prohibit funds made available to the Department of Justice from being used to make a personal payment to the President in connection with a claim that is subject to the Federal Tort Claims Act, whether in the form of a settlement or any other payment from the Judgment Fund for the personal benefit of the President.
